sn47.47:1.1: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena Bhagavā || la || pe || || 3.
sn47.47:1.2: Sādhu me bhante Bhagavā saṅkhittena dhammaṃ desetu || yam aham Bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto vihareyyanti || ||
sn47.47:1.3: Tasmā ti ha tvam bhikkhu ādim eva visodhehi kusalesu dhammesu ||
sn47.47:1.5: Idha tvam bhikkhu kāyaduccaritam pahāya kāyasucaritam bhāvessasi ||
sn47.47:1.8: Yato kho tvam bhikkhu kāyaduccaritam pahāya kāyasucaritam bhāvessasi || vacī- || mano- -sucaritam bhāvessasi || tato tvam bhikkhu sīlaṃ nissāya sīle patiṭṭhāya cattāro satipaṭṭhāne bhāvessasi ||
sn47.47:2.2: Idha tvam bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharāhi ||
sn47.47:2.5: Dhammesu dhammānupassī viharāhi ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ || || 6.
sn47.47:2.6: Yato kho tvam bhikkhu sīlaṃ nissāya sīle patiṭṭhāya ime cattāro satipaṭṭhāne evam bhāvessasi || tato tuyham bhikkhu yā ratti vā divaso vā āgamissati vuddhi yeva pāṭikaṅkhā kusalesu dhammesu no parihānī ti || || 7--8. ||la || || 9.
sn47.47:2.7: Aññataro ca pana so bhikkhu arahataṃ ahosī ti || || 1.
